profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Google Cloud Applied AI

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Tech Lead for Cloud's food ordering AI agent, steering technical strategy and execution across the full stack of customer-facing APIs, agent infrastructure, integrations, and UIs.
- Designed and delivered a generalized restaurant menu API compatible with industry standards, publicly documented @ https://docs.cloud.google.com/food-ai.
- Architected and launched a comprehensive full-stack web console from the ground up, enabling bidirectional audio streaming for real-time AI voice agent debugging, configuration, and monitoring.
- Led external integrations solving for OAuth 2.0 account linking, secret management, and secure webhook handling between internal infrastructure and third parties.
- Designed and (physically) built / deployed custom embedded hardware integrations to bridge the last-mile between the software product and customers' operational reality.
- Identified, designed, and productionized end-to-end systems optimizations to drastically reduce AI voice ordering latency and improve real-time interactions:
     - Eliminated a bottleneck in highest traffic tool call by adding a cache layer, reducing P50 search latency from ~120ms to ~1ms.
     - Adopted noise suppression tech from across Google to improve end-of-speech detection, reducing P95 voice response latency by 2.5 seconds.
     - Optimized database indices yielding an 80% reduction in mean database read latency and 1 second reduction in P99 end-to-end latency of agent voice responses.
- Drove core architectural and UX decisions during a rapid, resource-constrained initiative to evolve Dialogflow's no-code agent builder into an LLM-centric agent platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Automating food-order-taking for restaurants using Google's best large language & speech models

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building Conversational AI platforms in Google Cloud:
- Scaleable, fully-automated voice order taking for restaurants
- Vertex agents - A platform for building and serving production-ready conversational AI apps powered by Google's latest LLMs.
- See https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow/vertex/docs/concept/agents, https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow.

Product, automation, and infrastructure in Google Play's Growth & Monetization teams:
- Designed and launched features in the Google Play Store. Conducted experiments, A/B testing features across tens of millions of users.
- Designed and built automation for regulatory compliance.

Tech includes: Java, TypeScript, Angular, Spanner, many Google frameworks equivalent to Spring, Apache Beam, Hadoop, HDFS, Postgres, Kubernetes, ...

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built features for the Roadie crowdsourced same-day delivery platform, including 2FA, improvements to the pricing algorithm, automation for user notifications and reports, and more. Also designed and built an app from scratch enabling 1-click service deployments to Kubernetes in AWS EKS.

Built APIs in Python (Django) & Ruby (Rails) in Kubernetes on AWS using Kafka and Postgres.
(Acquired by UPS)
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Kafka · Distributed Systems · Ruby on Rails · Amazon EKS · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Go (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Terraform · Django · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built microservices in distributed, event sourced architecture on Kafka/RabbitMQ
- Tapped for Site Reliability Engineering team for expertise in observability, reliability, automation
- Built continuously deployed, customer facing web apps from the ground up, and built on large mature systems using Nodejs/Java Spring/Angular
- Contributed to monitoring/observability tools and libraries shared across teams using NestJS, Java/Spring Boot, node/express, Go, using MongoDB, SQL, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis
- Reworked lots of complex legacy services onto containers+Kubernetes
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Kafka · Java · Spring Boot · Distributed Systems · TypeScript · MongoDB · Kubernetes · Spring Framework · Express.js · Angular · Microsoft SQL Server · Terraform · Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Wrote a portable agent for corporate network penetration testing using Golang + Python.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching assistant for advanced undergrad courses. Taught students, built course material, and wrote scripts for automated grading of programming assignments.
*Intro to Robotics and Perception*
- Instructed and built/assessed course material consisting of projects implementing computer vision and robotic planning algorithms with Python, OpenCV, Numpy, TensorFlow, Scikit

*Intro to Computer Graphics*
- Instructed and built/assessed course material consisting of projects implementing ray-tracing based renderers, rasterization-based renderers, dynamic animation generation, and GPU-based shader programming with OpenGL and GLSL
positions.insights: Skills: TensorFlow · OpenGL · Computer Science · Scikit-Learn · Teaching · NumPy · OpenCV · OpenGL Shading Language (GLSL) · Python (Programming Language)
